claims.evidence: Witness only reports visible machine features; no test/operation footage or fault indicators shown.
Brand/model/nameplate details are not readable in the photos.
No running video/clip or sound/operation confirmation is included in the witness report.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: Photos do not show included accessories or the manual.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong

risks.risk: Unclear exact printing process/type (flexo/offset/screen/other) and therefore mismatched expectations for consumables, setup, and output quality.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the process/label area and any specification plate, plus a shot of the printing unit markings (e.g., cylinder/plate type) and the full feed/registration section.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic industrial printing/packaging press with unknown process and unknown output quality.

risks.risk: Working condition not proven (may have mechanical wear, roller issues, misalignment, or electrical faults not visible in still photos).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, motor start, roller movement, and a test run feeding material through the guide rails (with the control panel functioning).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working; treat as needing inspection/possible servicing.

risks.risk: Brand/model and capacity unknown; affects spare parts availability and resale value.
risks.proof: Readable nameplate/specification plate photo showing brand, model, serial number, year, and electrical ratings.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for unknown model/capacity and limited parts certainty.

risks.risk: Spare parts/accessories and consumables may be missing (rollers, belts/gears, plates/cylinders, electrical spares).
risks.proof: A photo inventory laid out on the floor/table showing each accessory/spare item, plus close-ups of any included rollers/cylinders and the manual cover.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories/spares are incomplete or not included.

risks.risk: Safety guards and electrical condition may be incomplete or degraded (not fully visible in the photos).
risks.proof: Full perimeter photos showing all guards/cover panels installed, and a close-up of the electrical cabinet with no exposed wiring; plus a safety interlock check video if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price with safety/installation risk considered (may require rework before use).

risks.risk: Electrical specs/power requirements unknown; may not match available supply in Lagos or may require additional components.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the electrical rating plate (voltage/phase/Hz) and the main wiring/circuit breaker ratings.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming additional electrical adaptation/inspection may be required.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the nameplate/specification plate (brand, model, serial number, year, electrical ratings).
Provide a short video of a full start-up and test run: motor running, rollers moving, and material/film feeding through the guide rails with the control panel operating.
Show an inventory photo of all included accessories/spares and the original manual (manual cover + any part numbers).
Capture close-ups of the printing/roller section showing adjustment points and any wear (surface condition of rollers/cylinders).
Show full safety guard coverage (all covers/guards installed) and a photo of the electrical cabinet interior/exterior condition.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as an industrial printing/packaging press, so it can be priced at its worst-case for unknown model, unknown working proof, and unknown included accessories; seller claims remain unverified.
